explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1121 (Goodman–Goodman theorem). 'Circles' are read as closed discs. The non-separability hypothesis says that every line {⟨v,p⟩ = t} missing all the discs has all their centres on one side, which is equivalent to no disc-avoiding line splitting the discs into two nonempty groups. The conclusion is that the union of discs lies in one disc of radius Σr_i.
